name: @petal/mobile
description: Petal Mobile Companion App (React Native + Local Preview)

scripts.build:apk: vite build preview/ --config preview/vite.config.ts && rm -rf android/app/src/main/assets/web && cp -r preview/dist android/app/src/main/assets/web && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../release && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../release/petal-v0.1.0.apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../../../petal-v0.1.0.apk
